_comment: Copy to ./porter.json (project) or the user config path from `porter config list`. Every key is optional; unset keys use the defaults shown here. API keys may instead come from OPENAI_API_KEY / WHISPER_API_KEY, which is safer than putting them in a file.

asr._comment: engine: null walks the fallback chain. Transcription needs a key (whisper_api_key, or llm.api_key) or the VideoCaptioner CLI -- the key-free speech endpoints no longer work.

ffmpeg._comment: auto_tune adjusts preset and crf to the detected hardware tier. Leave video_codec alone unless you have a reason; the burn phase selects the real encoder itself.

style._comment: ASS subtitle styling. Sizes are in pixels at the video's own resolution; vertical videos are detected and margins adapt.
